title: LTX 2.3 foley - wire the proven bench workflow into the app as a Flow
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-560 - The Flow track (merge of MPI-529 + MPI-552 + MPI-560, 2026-08-16). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-560/plan.md.

SHIPPED app-side 2026-08-14 as the Flow `ltx-foley` - declared controls, no uiComponent, authored from the ltx-extend shape. Workflow renamed raw/ltx_v2v_foley_template.json -> raw/flow_ltx_foley.json and converted against the APP engine 48188. Op flowLtxFoley in all 4 files. Evidence: tasks/MPI-536/validation.md. Doc: docs/playbooks/add-flow/existing-flows/ltx-foley.md.

THE PREREQ IS DONE: ltx-2.3-22b-lora-foley-v2a-1.0.safetensors is staged to R2 (216.21MB, public HEAD 200) and wired as dep `ltx23-lora-foley` on `ltx-23-balanced` ONLY - the graph bakes the int8 transformer, so the High card cannot run the Flow. NO mirrorUrl: the only upstream copy (Lightricks/LTX-2.3-22b-LoRA-Foley-V2A) is a GATED repo, 401 GatedRepo for an anonymous fetch.

DECISION THIS CARD OWNED, SETTLED: v1 ships FOLEY MODE ONLY. Voice mode has never been run and is mutually exclusive with foley, so no audio slot is declared and its nodes stay at bench defaults.

CLOSED 2026-08-14: Fabio ran the live generation in his own app and approved the result - "spot-on with what I asked for". Also carried forward: no length cap yet (long clips OOM, ceiling unmeasured).
